title: BDLF-Qwen3: Enhanced Cross-Architecture Binary Function Similarity Detection Through Binary Dynamic Layer Fusion

layout.note: Top row of three rounded frames (collections, Ghidra pipeline, and a tall Training Stage frame that continues downward with two stacked stage boxes); the fourth frame, Binary Dynamic Layer Fusion, spans the bottom left and is tied to the Stage-2 box by two dashed grey lines. Yellow block arrows join the frames.

lesson: Chain the main stages with yellow block arrows and give the new module its own titled frame tied to the stage that uses it by two dashed lines, so the overview stays light and the detail still sits one glance away.
